messages:
Sasha M: Hi team — quick heads up, I submitted my resignation today. My last day will be 2025-07-18. Leaving for a new role, happy to help with handoff. Can we coordinate the offboarding timeline (benefits/COBRA, final pay, access removal, device return, equity questions)? I'm PST-based.

Nina (People Ops): Sorry to see you go Sasha :wave: We'll set up the exit interview and start the offboard checklist. Can you confirm final day (2025-07-18) and any planned PTO in your last two weeks?

Sasha M: Confirmed last day 2025-07-18. I'll take 07/16-07/17 as PTO. Happy to be available for 2 days of handoff before PTO.

Ava (Payroll): Hi Sasha — noted. Final pay will include accrued PTO unless you opt otherwise. Standard payroll run means final payment on 2025-07-22. COBRA packet will be emailed within 7 days after termination. Benefits termination date is 2025-07-18 EOD.

Sam (Eng): Bummer to see you go. For engineering handoff: please leave a short runbook for the /api-routing service, add me as backup owner on the two repos, and mark any outstanding PRs you want someone to pick up. I'll take over your oncall shifts after 07/18.

Sasha M: Will do. I'll add a runbook to /docs/oncall/routing.md and upload a 5-min walkthrough video.

IT Ops: Sasha — we'll send a pre-paid shipping label for laptop return. Please back up any personal files and wipe personal data before shipping. We'll schedule Okta and device deprovision for 2025-07-18 at 18:00 PST. Asset tag: RDW-4567.

Sasha M: I have one KMS key and a Vault secret to transfer: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 and vault path secret/data/infra/routing. I'll either transfer ownership or mark for rotation.

Sam (Eng): If you can list all services you have ownership on (GitHub org repos, AWS roles, GCP projects, PagerDuty, Terraform state), we will rotate credentials or add owners. I'll add myself to the two repos now.

PeopleOps Bot: Exit interview scheduled: 2025-07-15 14:00 PST with Nina. Calendar invite sent: https://cal.link/peopleops/sasha-exit. Reminder will go out 24h before.

Nina (People Ops): Equity note: vesting generally stops on separation date per grant terms. Any acceleration requests need Legal/TotalComp review. Looping in those teams separately. We'll attach the COBRA enrollment link and benefits packet to your employment email.

Ava (Payroll): COBRA enrollment window: 60 days from benefits termination (2025-07-18). We will email instructions and the portal link. Final payroll/bonus proration needs manager confirmation for any non-standard payouts.

IT Ops: We will perform KMS key rotation on 2025-07-19 02:00 UTC if key ownership not transferred by 07/18 23:00 PST. GitHub org membership will be removed 2025-07-18 18:00 PST. Please ensure repos have a backup owner.

Sam (Eng): I confirmed backup ownership on the two repos and updated the runbook. Sasha — could you drop the runbook link here when ready?

Sasha M: Done: /docs/oncall/routing.md and a short video: https://share.example.com/sasha-routing.mp4. Also added a checklist of outstanding PRs and who to ping.

Nina (People Ops): Offboarding checklist summary: 1) exit interview (07/15) 2) asset return label (IT) 3) Okta/GitHub/AWS deprovision (07/18 EOD) 4) KMS rotation if not transferred 5) COBRA packet emailed 6) payroll final pay processed (07/22). Anyone want to add items?

Sam (Eng): Oncall reassignment completed. I'll take the post-exit pager for 2 weeks. :+1:

PeopleOps Bot: Offboarding tasks updated: https://internal/peopleops/offboarding/2407778888 — checkboxes updated. :white_check_mark:

Sasha M: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick coordination. I'll be available for knowledge transfer through 07/18. Happy to answer follow-ups via email or Slack for two weeks after. :heart:
